Yuvraj Singh Joins Delhi Capitals as Assistant and Batting Coach

Cricketer Yuvraj Singh has been appointed as the Assistant and Batting Coach for the Delhi Capitals team for the IPL 2027 season. He will work alongside Head Coach Sourav Ganguly. Yuvraj Singh expressed his commitment to giving his all for the team and aiming to make them champions. This marks Yuvraj Singh's first coaching role with an IPL team.
